title: The Rights of Children upon Their Parents in Tarbiyah

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, mentioning Prophetic hadiths that urge the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It also highlights the importance of treating children with justice and mercy. Parents must guide their children toward goodness and avoid oppression.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses 'الآباء' (fathers), but the English generalizes to 'Parents', which includes mothers and is not specified in the source.
'الظلم' means injustice or wrongdoing broadly; 'oppression' is narrower and may imply systemic tyranny, slightly altering the nuance.
